s0201.literal: On guiwei day Jupiter transgressed Fang.
s0201.idiomatic: On guiwei day Jupiter transgressed Fang.

s0202.literal: On bingxu day the chief and deputy darughachis of the artisan offices at Liao River and other places were abolished.
s0202.idiomatic: On bingxu day the chief and deputy darughachis of the artisan offices at Liao River and other places were abolished.

s0203.literal: On dinghai day Jupiter transgressed Hooked Clasp.
s0203.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jupiter transgressed Hooked Clasp.

s0204.literal: On jiawu day, because Princes Huangwu'er, imperial son-in-law Ashi, and others were all in the army, they were additionally granted gold, silver, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and clothing in varying amounts.
s0204.idiomatic: On jiawu day, because Princes Huangwu'er, imperial son-in-law Ashi, and others were all in the army, they were additionally granted gold, silver, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and clothing in varying amounts.

s0205.literal: On yiwei day, because the thousand households that Boyao had taken over from Hulachu were suffering famine, 10,000 ingots of paper money were granted.
s0205.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because the thousand households that Boyao had taken over from Hulachu were suffering famine, 10,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0206.literal: On renchen day the Moon transgressed Ghost.
s0206.idiomatic: On renchen day the Moon transgressed Ghost.

s0207.literal: On wuxu day those who harassed farming and sericulture were forbidden.
s0207.idiomatic: On wuxu day those who harassed farming and sericulture were forbidden.

s0208.literal: On gengzi day the Moon transgressed Fang and also transgressed Jupiter.
s0208.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Moon transgressed Fang and also transgressed Jupiter.

s0209.literal: Elite troops of a thousand men were selected from each guard; Borohadai and others were ordered to command them and garrison Karakorum, under the command of Grand Preceptor Yue'erlu, with rotation every three years.
s0209.idiomatic: Elite troops of a thousand men were selected from each guard; Borohadai and others were ordered to command them and garrison Karakorum, under the command of Grand Preceptor Yue'erlu, with rotation every three years.

s0210.literal: At the Imperial Preceptor's memorial, thirty persons sentenced to capital punishment in the capital were released, and one hundred sentenced to beating or below;
s0210.idiomatic: At the imperial preceptor's memorial, thirty persons sentenced to capital punishment in the capital were released, and one hundred sentenced to beating or below;

s0211.literal: 200 ingots of paper money were granted to all widows, orphans, and poor people.
s0211.idiomatic: 200 ingots of paper money were granted to all widows, orphans, and poor people.

s0212.literal: Native officials of Qujing, Chengjiang, Pu'an, and other routes each brought tribute goods.
s0212.idiomatic: Native officials of Qujing, Chengjiang, Pu'an, and other routes each brought tribute goods.

s0213.literal: Because cattle-relay households at Dongsheng and other places were impoverished, more than 3,000 ingots of paper money were granted.
s0213.idiomatic: Because cattle-relay households at Dongsheng and other places were impoverished, more than 3,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0214.literal: Bu'ali, envoy to Mehrbal, returned to the capital.
s0214.idiomatic: Bu'ali, envoy to Mehrbal, returned to the capital.

s0215.literal: Because Asimin had been captured by Qaidu, 39,900 ingots of paper money were granted.
s0215.idiomatic: Because Asimin had been captured by Qaidu, 39,900 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0216.literal: This month, Changde, Yue, E, and Hanyang prefectures suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.
s0216.idiomatic: This month, Changde, Yue, E, and Hanyang prefectures suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.

s0217.literal: This year, thirty-one persons were executed by decapitation.
s0217.idiomatic: This year, 31 persons were executed by decapitation.

s0218.literal: Yuanzhen reign year 1, spring, first month, wushen day: Prince Ashihan came to court; he was granted 50 taels of gold and 450 taels of silver.
s0218.idiomatic: Yuanzhen reign year 1, spring, first month, wushen day: Prince Ashihan came to court; he was granted 50 taels of gold and 450 taels of silver.

s0219.literal: On guichou day Zhihe Lang, minister of the Imperial Stud, was made censor-in-chief.
s0219.idiomatic: On guichou day Zhihe Lang, minister of the Imperial Stud, was made censor-in-chief.

s0220.literal: On jiayin day, for the merit of accompanying Kublai Khan on the Hang-Hai hunt, Prince Hulachu was granted 50 taels of gold and a string of pearls.
s0220.idiomatic: On jiayin day, for the merit of accompanying Kublai Khan on the Hang-Hai hunt, Prince Hulachu was granted 50 taels of gold and a string of pearls.

s0221.literal: On yimao day the Moon transgressed Saturn and also transgressed Net.
s0221.idiomatic: On yimao day the Moon transgressed Saturn and also transgressed Net.

s0222.literal: On renxu day, because of the national mourning anniversary, 70,000 monks were fed at the Great Sage Longevity Ten-Thousand Peace Monastery.
s0222.idiomatic: On renxu day, because of the national mourning anniversary, 70,000 monks were fed at the Great Sage Longevity Ten-Thousand Peace Monastery.

s0223.literal: On guihai day Prince Anxi Ananda and Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu both said their domains were impoverished; Prince Anxi was granted 200,000 ingots of paper money and Prince Ningyuan 60,000 ingots.
s0223.idiomatic: On guihai day Prince Anxi Ananda and Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu both said their domains were impoverished; Prince Anxi was granted 200,000 ingots of paper money and Prince Ningyuan 60,000 ingots.

s0224.literal: Also because falling frost killed the grain crops, the people behind the mountains in Prince Anxi's domain were again given relief of 10,000 shi of rice.
s0224.idiomatic: Also because falling frost killed the grain crops, the people behind the mountains in Prince Anxi's domain were again given relief of 10,000 shi of rice.

s0225.literal: An edict ordered the Daoist school again to practice the Golden Register and Rubrics.
s0225.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Daoist school again to practice the Golden Register and Rubrics.

s0226.literal: Yang Yanlong, left associate of the Yunnan branch secretariat, was made left associate of the central secretariat.
s0226.idiomatic: Yang Yanlong, left associate of the Yunnan branch secretariat, was made left associate of the central secretariat.

s0227.literal: On yichou day Yixi Busi was again subordinated to the Yunnan branch secretariat;
s0227.idiomatic: On yichou day Yixi Busi was again subordinated to the Yunnan branch secretariat;

s0228.literal: because the branch secretariat for military affairs had been abolished, branch secretariat chiefs were granted tiger tallies to command the troops.
s0228.idiomatic: because the branch secretariat for military affairs had been abolished, branch secretariat chiefs were granted tiger tallies to command the troops.

s0229.literal: On gengwu day Alawading, pacification commissioner of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made vice grand councilor.
s0229.idiomatic: On gengwu day Alawading, pacification commissioner of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made vice grand councilor.

s0230.literal: On renshen day the Beiting chief commander's office was established; Hebo, pacification commissioner, was made chief commander, and Sariman, right associate of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made deputy chief commander; all wore tiger tallies.
s0230.idiomatic: On renshen day the Beiting chief commander's office was established; Hebo, pacification commissioner, was made chief commander, and Sariman, right associate of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made deputy chief commander; all wore tiger tallies.

s0231.literal: The Quxian Taling chief commander's office was established; Xinducha was made chief commander and wore a tiger tally.
s0231.idiomatic: The Quxian Taling chief commander's office was established; Xinducha was made chief commander and wore a tiger tally.

s0232.literal: Raozhou route darughachi Alahong and administrative aide Zhao Liang acted illegally; investigative officials of the Jiangdong surveillance commission, Xiban and Jirang, accepted bribes and released them; when the matter was discovered, Xiban killed himself, Jirang was beaten and removed from the roster, and half his property and bond servants were confiscated.
s0232.idiomatic: Raozhou route darughachi Alahong and administrative aide Zhao Liang acted illegally; investigative officials of the Jiangdong surveillance commission, Xiban and Jirang, accepted bribes and released them; when the matter was discovered, Xiban killed himself, Jirang was beaten and removed from the roster, and half his property and bond servants were confiscated.

s0233.literal: Gua, Sha, and other prefectures' military colonies were abolished.
s0233.idiomatic: Gua, Sha, and other prefectures' military colonies were abolished.

s0234.literal: On guiyou day Jupiter transgressed Eastern Winnowing.
s0234.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jupiter transgressed Eastern Winnowing.

s0235.literal: On jiaxu day there was a flying letter falsely claiming Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan had treasonous designs; an edict instructed the court and provinces to console and encourage them.
s0235.idiomatic: On jiaxu day there was a flying letter falsely claiming Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan had treasonous designs; an edict instructed the court and provinces to console and encourage them.

s0236.literal: On yihai day the imperial maternal uncle Ajinai'an was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jining with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial; the imperial aunt Princess Nangjiachen was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Lu; and imperial son-in-law Manzitai was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining and granted a gold seal.
s0236.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial maternal uncle Ajinai'an was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jining with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial; the imperial aunt Princess Nangjiachen was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Lu; and imperial son-in-law Manzitai was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining and granted a gold seal.

s0237.literal: An edict ordered the salt transport commissions of the various circuits to be regulated.
s0237.idiomatic: An edict ordered the salt transport commissions of the various circuits to be regulated.

s0238.literal: Second month, bingzi new moon: Prince Anxi's chancellor Tiechi and others requested reestablishment of the prince's chancellor's office; this was not permitted.
s0238.idiomatic: Second month, bingzi new moon: Prince Anxi's chancellor Tiechi and others requested reestablishment of the prince's chancellor's office; this was not permitted.

s0239.literal: Shaanxi Province officials were ordered to supply their needs, and confiscated bribe-fine paper money from the surveillance commission was given to them.
s0239.idiomatic: Shaanxi Province officials were ordered to supply their needs, and confiscated bribe-fine paper money from the surveillance commission was given to them.

s0240.literal: On dingchou day Hanlin academician-expositor Liu Mengyan requested retirement on grounds of age; the Emperor, because in the previous reign he had spoken without concealment, richly rewarded him and sent him away.
s0240.idiomatic: On dingchou day Hanlin academician-expositor Liu Mengyan requested retirement on grounds of age; the Emperor, because in the previous reign he had spoken without concealment, richly rewarded him and sent him away.

s0241.literal: Hebo, Sariman, and Bolai were ordered to lead ten thousand tammaq troops on campaign, under the command of Prince Chuban.
s0241.idiomatic: Hebo, Sariman, and Bolai were ordered to lead 10,000 tammaq troops on campaign, under the command of Prince Chuban.

s0242.literal: On renwu day the Jiangnan tea tax was abolished; its amount of 3,000 ingots was added to the annual quota of the Jiangxi Tea Monopoly Transport Commission.
s0242.idiomatic: On renwu day the Jiangnan tea tax was abolished; its amount of 3,000 ingots was added to the annual quota of the Jiangxi Tea Monopoly Transport Commission.

s0243.literal: An edict ordered that those who borrowed ortoq funds and then fled and concealed themselves should be punished, and the money should be given as reward to the first informer.
s0243.idiomatic: An edict ordered that those who borrowed ortoq funds and then fled and concealed themselves should be punished, and the money should be given as reward to the first informer.

s0244.literal: On guiwei day Mars transgressed the Moon.
s0244.idiomatic: On guiwei day Mars transgressed the Moon.

s0245.literal: On dinghai day Ye Xianbuhua, pacification commissioner of the Yunnan branch secretariat, said: "In Ganmalu two tribes have not yet submitted; Jinzhi also rebels and submits irregularly; we request 6,000 troops be dispatched to pacify Jinzhi and relay stations established to enter Burma.
s0245.idiomatic: On dinghai day Ye Xianbuhua, pacification commissioner of the Yunnan branch secretariat, said, "In Ganmalu two tribes have not yet submitted; Jinzhi also rebels and submits irregularly; we request 6,000 troops be dispatched to pacify Jinzhi and relay stations established to enter Burma.

s0247.literal: The Escort Guard Office was again made rank 3a.
s0247.idiomatic: The Escort Guard Office was again made rank 3a.

s0248.literal: Because the Hongjili people under Prince of Jining Manzitai were impoverished, 180,000 ingots of paper money were granted.
s0248.idiomatic: Because the Hongjili people under Prince of Jining Manzitai were impoverished, 180,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0249.literal: On wuzi day Sinzhou's Tian Heilabuhua, Yunnan tribesman Bumu, Sichuan cave lord Chachawang, Jinzhi chieftain Dai Meihundong, and others came to audience.
s0249.idiomatic: On wuzi day Sinzhou's Tian Heilabuhua, Yunnan tribesman Bumu, Sichuan cave lord Chachawang, Jinzhi chieftain Dai Meihundong, and others came to audience.

s0250.literal: Burma's Alazha Gaoweiban came to offer relics and precious objects.
s0250.idiomatic: Burma's Alazha Gaoweiban came to offer relics and precious objects.

s0251.literal: On jiawu day, because tammaq troops were setting out on campaign and horses were insufficient, an edict ordered exempting neither soldiers, civilians, nor officials — all who had horses were conscripted.
s0251.idiomatic: On jiawu day, because tammaq troops were setting out on campaign and horses were insufficient, an edict ordered exempting neither soldiers, civilians, nor officials — all who had horses were conscripted.

s0252.literal: On renchen day the Moon transgressed Flat Road.
s0252.idiomatic: On renchen day the Moon transgressed Flat Road.

s0253.literal: On dingyou day the Emperor visited Shangdu.
s0253.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Emperor visited Shangdu.

s0254.literal: On guimao day the Moon transgressed Jupiter.
s0254.idiomatic: On guimao day the Moon transgressed Jupiter.

s0255.literal: Because the horse-and-cattle relay personnel of Prince Yilianzhen's domain were impoverished, 1,000 ingots of paper money were granted.
s0255.idiomatic: Because the horse-and-cattle relay personnel of Prince Yilianzhen's domain were impoverished, 1,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0256.literal: Lü Tianlin, minister of works concurrently darughachi of the Directorate General of Gold, Jade, and Artisans of all routes, was made vice grand councilor of the central secretariat.
s0256.idiomatic: Lü Tianlin, minister of works concurrently darughachi of the Directorate General of Gold, Jade, and Artisans of all routes, was made vice grand councilor of the central secretariat.

s0257.literal: The Yunzhou Silver Mine Chief Intendant Office was established at rank 4b.
s0257.idiomatic: The Yunzhou Silver Mine Chief Intendant Office was established at rank 4b.

s0258.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently Ahmad and Sangha used their power to sell offices without distinguishing ability — appointments and transfers relied solely on certificates of dismissal — and thereby the selection system was greatly corrupted.
s0258.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Recently Ahmad and Sangha used their power to sell offices without distinguishing ability — appointments and transfers relied solely on certificates of dismissal — and thereby the selection system was greatly corrupted.

s0259.literal: Surveillance commissions should investigate and report; provincial and censorate officials should be selected to verify the facts, determine grades of merit, and thereby clarify promotion and demotion.
s0259.idiomatic: Surveillance commissions should investigate and report; provincial and censorate officials should be selected to verify the facts, determine grades of merit, and thereby clarify promotion and demotion.

s0260.literal: Surveillance commission officials too should jointly be selected by the secretariat and censorate.
s0260.idiomatic: Surveillance commission officials too should jointly be selected by the secretariat and censorate.

s0262.literal: The Hexi army was abolished; each was permitted to return to its original assignment.
s0262.idiomatic: The Hexi army was abolished; each was permitted to return to its original assignment.

s0263.literal: Imperial son-in-law Nawuai was granted 15,000 ingots of paper money.
s0263.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Nawuai was granted 15,000 ingots of paper money.

s0264.literal: Because of a rite at the Ever-Spring Pavilion, Celestial Master Zhang Yudi, Patriarch Zhang Liusun, Perfected Man Zhang Zhixian, and twelve others were each granted one jade tablet.
s0264.idiomatic: Because of a rite at the Ever-Spring Pavilion, Celestial Master Zhang Yudi, Patriarch Zhang Liusun, Perfected Man Zhang Zhixian, and twelve others were each granted one jade tablet.

s0265.literal: A jeweled Five-Directions Buddha crown was made and granted to the Imperial Preceptor.
s0265.idiomatic: A jeweled Five-Directions Buddha crown was made and granted to the imperial preceptor.

s0266.literal: Third month, yisi new moon: Annam's heir Chen Riti sent envoys submitting a memorial to console the nation in mourning, also submitting a letter thanking the Emperor for clemency, and presenting tribute goods.
s0266.idiomatic: Third month, yisi new moon: Annam's heir Chen Riti sent envoys submitting a memorial to console the nation in mourning, also submitting a letter thanking the Emperor for clemency, and presenting tribute goods.

s0267.literal: On bingwu day Misizhang was dispatched with 50,000 ingots of paper money to grant the western campaign grand marshal, ordering purchase of ten thousand horses to be distributed among impoverished officers and soldiers of the twenty-four garrisons.
s0267.idiomatic: On bingwu day Misizhang was dispatched with 50,000 ingots of paper money to grant the western campaign grand marshal, ordering purchase of 10,000 horses to be distributed among impoverished officers and soldiers of the twenty-four garrisons.

s0268.literal: On gengxu day the Moon transgressed Saturn.
s0268.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Moon transgressed Saturn.

s0269.literal: On renzi day officials coming to court were forbidden to collect the salaries of their subordinates.
s0269.idiomatic: On renzi day officials coming to court were forbidden to collect the salaries of their subordinates.

s0270.literal: On bingchen day 10,000 shi of fried millet were issued to Yue'erlu and Tutu armies.
s0270.idiomatic: On bingchen day 10,000 shi of fried millet were issued to Yue'erlu and Tutu armies.

s0271.literal: Jinzhi Yi cave tribesmen came to audience; clothing was granted and they were sent away.
s0271.idiomatic: Jinzhi Yi cave tribesmen came to audience; clothing was granted and they were sent away.

s0272.literal: On wuwu day the Fujian Silver Mine Intendant Office was abolished; its annual silver quota was placed under regular officials.
s0272.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Fujian Silver Mine Intendant Office was abolished; its annual silver quota was placed under regular officials.

s0273.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "The Bureau of Military Affairs and the Censorate by precedent should submit nominations for their staff; other offices should not submit such requests — yet now all do so, which is inconvenient.
s0273.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "The Bureau of Military Affairs and the Censorate by precedent should submit nominations for their staff; other offices should not submit such requests — yet now all do so, which is inconvenient.

s0274.literal: " An edict ordered that from now on the central secretariat alone should draft submissions.
s0274.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on the central secretariat alone should draft submissions.

s0275.literal: Because spring plowing was at its peak, all non-urgent construction was halted, except the Imperial Preceptor's pagoda and Master Zhang's palace.
s0275.idiomatic: Because spring plowing was at its peak, all non-urgent construction was halted, except the imperial preceptor's pagoda and Master Zhang's palace.

s0276.literal: On renxu day there was an earthquake.
s0276.idiomatic: On renxu day there was an earthquake.

s0278.literal: On bingyin day King Hetong concealed the 350 ingots of paper money granted to impoverished people of his domain; censorate officials were ordered to send men to investigate and shame him.
s0278.idiomatic: On bingyin day King Hetong concealed the 350 ingots of paper money granted to impoverished people of his domain; censorate officials were ordered to send men to investigate and shame him.

s0279.literal: An edict ordered exemption of corvee labor for medical and artisan households.
s0279.idiomatic: An edict ordered exemption of corvee labor for medical and artisan households.

s0280.literal: Mongol school instructors were additionally established, to be overseen by the rectification surveillance commissions of each circuit.
s0280.idiomatic: Mongol school instructors were additionally established, to be overseen by the rectification surveillance commissions of each circuit.

s0281.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinsi day: the sorcerer Meng Chong presumptuously imitated the emperor, and he and his thirteen accomplices were executed.
s0281.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, xinsi day: the sorcerer Meng Chong presumptuously imitated the emperor, and he and his thirteen accomplices were executed.

s0282.literal: Impovershed relay households from Zhanghe to Kuyan were granted more than 12,900 ingots of paper money.
s0282.idiomatic: Impovershed relay households from Zhanghe to Kuyan were granted more than 12,900 ingots of paper money.

s0283.literal: On bingxu day Prince Yazhili garrisoned the Ulus frontier with five thousand troops and sent envoys requesting horses; the Emperor did not approve.
s0283.idiomatic: On bingxu day Prince Yazhili garrisoned the Ulus frontier with 5,000 troops and sent envoys requesting horses; the Emperor did not approve.

s0284.literal: On gengyin day the Moon transgressed Eastern Winnowing.
s0284.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Moon transgressed Eastern Winnowing.

s0285.literal: Wet nurse Lady Yang was enfeoffed as Lady Anyi of Zhao.
s0285.idiomatic: Wet nurse Lady Yang was enfeoffed as Lady Anyi of Zhao.

s0286.literal: On guisi day Yanamu, associate commissioner of the Wusa-Wumeng and other places pacification commissioner's office, was given the provisional title minister of war, wore a tiger tally, and was sent as envoy to Mad'ar's Yin.
s0286.idiomatic: On guisi day Yanamu, associate commissioner of the Wusa-Wumeng and other places pacification commissioner's office, was given the provisional title minister of war, wore a tiger tally, and was sent as envoy to Mad'ar's Yin.

s0287.literal: On wuxu day 120,000 ingots of paper money were issued to tammaq troops accompanying the Emperor to purchase horses.
s0287.idiomatic: On wuxu day 120,000 ingots of paper money were issued to tammaq troops accompanying the Emperor to purchase horses.

s0288.literal: On gengzi day the Directorate of Audiences was established to manage the Empress Dowager's seal at rank 4b; eunuchs held the posts.
s0288.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Directorate of Audiences was established to manage the Empress Dowager's seal at rank 4b; eunuchs held the posts.

s0289.literal: Impovershed households of the keshik guard were granted more than 41,500 ingots of paper money.
s0289.idiomatic: Impovershed households of the keshik guard were granted more than 41,500 ingots of paper money.

s0290.literal: On guimao day one thousand tammaq troops and one thousand Red Jacket troops under Prince Chuban were subordinated to Prince of Xiping Oljei.
s0290.idiomatic: On guimao day 1,000 tammaq troops and 1,000 Red Jacket troops under Prince Chuban were subordinated to Prince of Xiping Oljei.

s0291.literal: Yin-yang instructors were established for each route; yin-yang practitioners were still forbidden to frequent the gates of princes and imperial sons-in-law.
s0291.idiomatic: Yin-yang instructors were established for each route; yin-yang practitioners were still forbidden to frequent the gates of princes and imperial sons-in-law.

s0292.literal: Because the domains of keshik wanhu Hutubuhua and others had been plundered by the enemy, paper money was granted in varying amounts.
s0292.idiomatic: Because the domains of keshik wanhu Hutubuhua and others had been plundered by the enemy, paper money was granted in varying amounts.

s0293.literal: This month, in Pingshan, Lingshou, and other counties of Zhending route insects ate mulberry trees.
s0293.idiomatic: This month, in Pingshan, Lingshou, and other counties of Zhending route insects ate mulberry trees.

s0294.literal: Intercalary fourth month, bingwu day: a Buddhist monastery was built for the Empress Dowager on Wutai Mountain; former minister of works Niezhi was made director of the Directorate of Palace Building and concurrently headed the Ministry of Works;
s0294.idiomatic: Intercalary fourth month, bingwu day: a Buddhist monastery was built for the Empress Dowager on Wutai Mountain; former minister of works Niezhi was made director of the Directorate of Palace Building and concurrently headed the Ministry of Works;

s0295.literal: Rectification surveillance commissioner of the Yan-Nan Hebei circuit Song Derou was made minister of works to oversee the project;
s0295.idiomatic: Rectification surveillance commissioner of the Yan-Nan Hebei circuit Song Derou was made minister of works to oversee the project;

s0296.literal: and the ten routes of Dadu, Baoding, Zhending, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Datong, Hejian, Daming, Shunde, and Guangping were to supply its needs.
s0296.idiomatic: and the ten routes of Dadu, Baoding, Zhending, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Datong, Hejian, Daming, Shunde, and Guangping were to supply its needs.

s0297.literal: On guichou day Jupiter transgressed Fang.
s0297.idiomatic: On guichou day Jupiter transgressed Fang.

s0298.literal: On jiayin day the Moon transgressed Flat Road.
s0298.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Moon transgressed Flat Road.

s0299.literal: The Suoli Pacification Commissioner's Office was established; Darhudai was made commissioner and wore a tiger tally.
s0299.idiomatic: The Suoli Pacification Commissioner's Office was established; Darhudai was made commissioner and wore a tiger tally.

s0300.literal: On yimao day the Moon transgressed Neck.
s0300.idiomatic: On yimao day the Moon transgressed Neck.
